2607.23440.title: Reasoning or Memorization: Can LLMs Understand and Generate Chinese Xiehouyu Riddles?
2607.23440.paper_summary: In this paper, we push the boundary of LLM reasoning by testing them in a Chinese language game, xiehouyu, with novel xiehouyu created by linguists that had not existed before to avoid data contamination. We use multiple-choice questions (MCQ), free-form explanation generation, and new xiehouyu creation to evaluate LLMs' ability to understand and create xiehouyu. In MCQ, we use the delta of accuracy ($Δ_{acc}$) between existing but low-frequency xiehouyu and novel ones as an index for memorization. $Δ_{acc}$ for native speakers is very low, suggesting similar processing mechanisms. However, we found that frontier Chinese models have on average a $Δ_{acc}$ of 23.6\%, while English-centric models tested have a mean $Δ_{acc}$ of 5.1\%, suggesting that frontier Chinese models are likely trained with much larger Chinese data, thus memorizing more low-frequency xiehouyu. For novel xiehouyu, Gemini 3.1 Pro demonstrated remarkable ability with acc 92.6, which is 24\% higher than human accuracy. In xiehouyu creation, those created by LLMs receive much worse ratings than those by humans. These results suggest that claims about the reasoning abilities of LLMs may need careful re-examination considering the data contamination issue, and that LLMs' creativity in language-related tasks may still be behind human experts, at least in Chinese xiehouyu.
2607.23440.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，我們通過在中文語言遊戲「歇後語」中測試大型語言模型（LLM），推進了LLM推理的邊界，使用了語言學家創造的全新歇後語，以避免數據污染。<lb/>我們使用多選題（MCQ）、自由形式的解釋生成以及新的歇後語創造來評估LLM理解和創造歇後語的能力。<lb/>在多選題中，我們使用現有但低頻的歇後語與新創的歇後語之間的準確率變化（$Δ_{acc}$）作為記憶的指標。<lb/>母語者的$Δ_{acc}$非常低，這表明其處理機制相似。<lb/>然而，我們發現前沿的中文模型平均$Δ_{acc}$為23.6\%，而測試的以英語為中心的模型平均$Δ_{acc}$為5.1\%，這表明前沿的中文模型可能使用了更大規模的中文數據進行訓練，因此記憶了更多低頻的歇後語。<lb/>對於新創的歇後語，Gemini 3.1 Pro展現了卓越的能力，準確率為92.6，這比人類的準確率高出24\%。<lb/>在歇後語創造方面，LLM創造的歇後語評價遠低於人類創造的。<lb/>這些結果表明，關於LLM推理能力的主張可能需要仔細重新檢視，考慮到數據污染問題，而LLM在語言相關任務中的創造力可能仍然落後於人類專家，至少在中文歇後語方面。
